Strategy module — the first three fixes

Drawn on Mobile's own pages, taken from today's platform, with only three changes from the Forefront house style (SMP Design System). The navigation rows on top are left as they are. Shown in your current theme; switch to see the other.

  1. Table headings: no navy blocks, small grey capitals over one line.
  2. No boxes inside boxes: frames become thin rules.
  3. A score is a small square and its word; big figures stay in normal ink.

Plan

Table headings lose the navy and become small grey capitals over a line. The pillar list, the pillar heading and both tables lose their boxes; a thin rule separates them. Nothing is removed.

SWOT

The four boxed cards with coloured top edges become four lists, each under one thin line. The words and numbers are unchanged.

Performance

Cards and tables lose their frames and navy headings. The big figures go back to normal ink; the small square and its word (Off track, Needs attention) carry the status, as the design system says.
